# Little Gasp

> Little Gasp (littlegasp.com) is an online gift studio from Mumbai, India. It makes personalised, interactive surprise websites: the buyer adds photos, short notes and a letter, watches the full preview free, pays once, and sends one private link that the other person taps and plays through on a phone or laptop.

- No app needed; the link opens in any browser and stays live for at least 12 months.
- Customer surprise pages are private (only people with the link) and hidden from search engines.
- Payment by UPI, card or net banking through Razorpay; the link appears instantly and is emailed.
- Buyers can upload their own song (MP3/M4A) on every design.
- Founder: Aniket Nandkumar Gurav, Mumbai. Instagram @littlegasp.co. Email littlegasp.orders@gmail.com.

## Surprise ideas by occasion

- [All digital surprises](https://littlegasp.com/digital-surprise-gifts/): Make a personalised, interactive digital surprise: a little website they play through, with your photos, notes and letter. Free preview, private link.
- [Apology website](https://littlegasp.com/apology-website/): Say sorry with a website they play: they mend a broken heart, read your sorries and tell you how mad they still are. Free preview, private link.
- [Birthday surprise website](https://littlegasp.com/birthday-surprise-website/): A birthday surprise website they play: candles, a wish, balloons and gifts with your photos, notes and letter inside. Free preview, link in minutes.
- [Digital love letter](https://littlegasp.com/digital-love-letter/): Send a love letter they open: crack the wax seal, unfold your notes and watch a quill write every word. With your photos. Free preview.
- [Anniversary surprise](https://littlegasp.com/anniversary-surprise-website/): An anniversary gift they ride through: kick-start the scooter and drive up memory lane, where every milestone is one of your photos. Free preview.
- [Proposal surprise website](https://littlegasp.com/proposal-surprise-website/): Propose with a treasure hunt: they search a dark house with a torch, watch your photos on a projector, then open the ring box. Free preview.
- [Long-distance relationship gift](https://littlegasp.com/long-distance-relationship-gift/): A long-distance gift: a paper plane flies from your city to theirs with your photos and letter, then lands as a boarding pass to pick the day you meet.
- [Karwa Chauth gift for wife](https://littlegasp.com/karwa-chauth-gift-for-wife/): A Karwa Chauth surprise for your wife: she raises the channi to the moon, lights diyas with your reasons and turns the thali for seven promises.
- [Diwali & Bhai Dooj surprise](https://littlegasp.com/diwali-surprise-website/): A Diwali surprise they light up: trace a rangoli, launch fireworks that write your wishes, release photo lanterns. For partner, family or Bhai Dooj.
- [Navratri surprise](https://littlegasp.com/navratri-garba-surprise/): A Navratri surprise: tap the dancing couple to light all nine nights, each opening a photo or reason, then play a dandiya round to the beat.

## Guides

- [Surprise website vs e-card, video message or a physical gift](https://littlegasp.com/surprise-website-vs-e-card/): An honest comparison of a surprise website, an e-card, a video message and a physical gift: cost, effort, distance, and which one fits your moment.
- [How to plan a surprise for a long-distance partner](https://littlegasp.com/long-distance-surprise-ideas/): A step-by-step guide to planning a surprise for a long-distance partner: timing across cities, what to say, photos to pick, and a plan to meet next.
- [What to write in an apology that actually lands](https://littlegasp.com/how-to-write-an-apology/): What to write in an apology to your partner or friend: name what you did, own how it felt for them, skip the excuses, promise something small and real.
